name: vaultkeeper-browser-extension
description: Vaultkeeper browser extension (thin client for the Vaultkeeper app)

scripts.package: RELEASE=1 node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir release --filename "vaultkeeper-chrome-{version}.zip" --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir release --filename "vaultkeeper-firefox-{version}.zip" --overwrite-dest
